(()=>{const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-dialog-heading button,.walk-start-footer button')].map(b=>{const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.height<44||r.width<44||!b.contains(document.elementFromPoint(r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2)))throw Error('Source picker target failure');return {name:b.textContent,rect:r.toJSON()}});return rows})()
